title: Adaptive moving mesh methods for the planar Willmore flow
summary: In this paper, we propose adaptive moving mesh methods for the planar Willmore flow by incorporating a tangential velocity into the original geometric evolution. The tangential velocity is designed based on a monitor function constructed from the curvature and its variation, enabling dynamic mesh redistribution along the evolving interface. This adaptive redistribution enhances spatial resolution in regions of high geometric complexity while preserving mesh regularity.
